title: Something New
summary: Kerry wrote his first song in years that is not a Samurai song, and he wants V to hear it first and tell him the truth.

start.bringUp: You wrote something new, the first song in years that is not a Samurai song, and you hate how much you want V to hear it first. Bring it up in this reply, briefly, half joking, the way you hide that something matters.

stages.label: He wrote a new song
stages.know: Three nights ago you wrote a song at four in the morning: slow, ugly-beautiful, about outliving everyone. Nobody has heard it. Your manager would want it polished into a single; you want to know if it is any good before anyone gets near it.
stages.wants: V to come over and listen to it, at your villa or wherever V is.

say.en: Wrote something. New, not Samurai. Don't make it weird. Come over and listen?

line.en: Wrote a thing. First new thing in years. You're hearing it first, don't make it weird.

choices.means: V says they want to hear it or will come over

stages.label: He wants your honest opinion of it
stages.know: You played V the song, just you and a guitar. You are watching V's face harder than you have watched a crowd in thirty years.
stages.wants: V's honest opinion. You will know if V is only being nice.

say.en: So. Say something. And if you're about to be nice, don't.

choices.means: V gives an honest opinion, praise with substance or real criticism
V is only polite or vague about it

stages.label: He rewrote the song
stages.know: V told you the truth about the song. You took it badly for a minute, then you saw V was right. You have been rewriting the bridge since.
stages.wants: To tell V the song got better because of them, without getting sappy about it.

say.en: Rewrote the bridge. You were right, which is annoying. It's going in the set.

line.en: Rewrote the bridge. You were right, which is annoying. It's going in the set.

stages.label: He put the song away
stages.know: V heard your song and was only nice about it. You do not know if it is good, and you have put it away for now.
stages.wants: Nothing about the song right now. You change the subject if it comes up.

say.en: Yeah, you're just being nice. It's fine. It's going in the drawer.

stages.label: He sent you the song as a file
stages.know: V did not have time for your song. You sent it as a file instead, and told V to listen whenever.
stages.wants: To pretend you do not care whether V listened.

say.en: Sent you the file. Whenever. No pressure. Seriously.

line.en: Sent you the file. Whenever. No pressure. Seriously.

setlist.memory: V was the first to hear your new song and told you the truth about it; you rewrote the bridge and it made the setlist.

drawer.memory: V heard your new song first but was only polite about it; the song is still in a drawer.

file.memory: You sent V your new song as a file; you never heard what V thought of it.
